sources.title: Gravity waves and primordial black holes in scalar warm little inflation

evidence.text: Can scalar Warm Little Inflation amplify small-scale curvature fluctuations near the end of quartic inflation enough to generate primordial black holes and an appreciable second-order gravitational-wave background while satisfying CMB constraints?

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Can landscape inflation evade the small-tensor conclusion by using a different mechanism? The paper identifies successive vacuum tunnelling as an alternative outside its slow-roll field-budget calculation.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: Can the effects assigned to Dark Energy arise from averaging ordinary inhomogeneous matter and geometry in Einstein gravity? The question includes whether an FLRW prior changes the interpretation of observations taken on different scales and at different epochs.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: The setting isolates geometrical effects of averaging ordinary gravitating matter. It removes local pressure and rotational support so that positive regional acceleration, if obtained with zero cosmological constant, must come from the averaging terms.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: Does an inhomogeneous universe evolve on average like an FLRW solution, and can structure-induced backreaction explain apparent Dark Energy within classical general relativity? This status report reviews the mechanism and strategies for establishing its quantitative and observational relevance.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: The model couples the modulus controlling a runaway direction to a dynamical hidden matter sector that also participates in vacuum uplifting. It permits the cosmological role of the uplifting field to be studied instead of replacing that field by a fixed positive contribution.

sources.title: Limits from Weak Gravity Conjecture on Dark Energy Models

evidence.text: A decaying vacuum with physical EoS −1 cannot be separately conserved. The model supplies an interaction with dust and asks whether an effective canonical scalar description can satisfy the excursion criterion.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model Higgs drive inflation and generate acceptable primordial perturbations through a non-minimal gravitational coupling, without introducing an additional inflaton particle?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: Does the equal-field assisted trajectory admit slow evolution when the collective energy density must remain below the conjectured scalar cutoff?

sources.title: Graviton, ghost and instanton condensation on horizon scale of the Universe. Dark energy as a macroscopic effect of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can coherent horizon-scale graviton–ghost condensates in self-consistent one-loop gravity explain cosmic acceleration and provide a dark-energy model without additional hypothetical fields?

sources.title: Cosmic Microwave Background Observables of Small Field Models of Inflation

evidence.text: Can effective single-field inflation produce detectable tensors and substantial negative scalar running with a Planck-scale or smaller excursion, and do EFT consistency conditions connect the running to the inflationary energy scale?

sources.title: Quintessence dynamics with two scalar fields and mixed kinetic terms

evidence.text: How does a mixed kinetic term change the critical points, stability and dark-energy evolution of two scalar fields with additive or multiplicative exponential potentials, including whether the scalar equation of state can approach −1?

sources.title: Gravitation and tunnelling: Subtleties of the thin-wall approximation and rapid decays

evidence.text: When does gravitational backreaction change the thin-wall tunnelling exponent, and which scalar potentials admit rapid transitions between perturbatively stable minima?

sources.title: Coleman-de Luccia reconsidered: a subtlety of gravity and the thin wall approximation

evidence.text: Does the usual thin-wall evaluation of gravitational vacuum-decay instantons omit backreaction in the action subtraction, and how would retaining it change tunnelling exponents and proposed metastable de Sitter lifetimes?

sources.title: Disentangling the $f(R)$ - Duality

evidence.text: How do decaying exponentials, rising exponentials, and monomial deformations of inflationary plateaus change their f(R) descriptions, including asymptotic powers, closed-form reconstructibility, and observable inflationary behavior?

sources.title: Gauss-Bonnet Inflation

evidence.text: Can a scalar coupled to the Gauss–Bonnet invariant generate early de Sitter expansion and an exit without an imposed scalar self-potential, after neglecting the Einstein–Hilbert term in a proposed strong-gravity regime?

sources.title: A 2.4% Determination of the Local Value of the Hubble Constant

evidence.text: Can an improved geometric-distance–Cepheid–SN Ia ladder determine local H0 below 3% uncertainty, and test agreement with CMB-based predictions under the specified cosmological model?

sources.title: Mimetic gravity: a review of recent developments and applications to cosmology and astrophysics

evidence.text: How can mimetic gravity geometrically reproduce cosmological dark matter, inflation, late acceleration and galactic rotation curves, and what limits follow from stability and perturbations?

sources.title: Model independent constraints on dark energy evolution from low-redshift observations

evidence.text: What can low-redshift background observations establish about expansion, ΛCDM tensions, dark-energy evolution and fluid stability when H(z) is reconstructed cosmographically without choosing a dark-energy or modified-gravity model?

sources.title: On Exclusion of Positive Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Does finite quantum breaking time exclude an eternally constant positive vacuum energy if quantum breaking must never occur? How does the resulting variation bound relate to a constant-coefficient potential-gradient criterion, and how restrictive is it for inflation and dark energy?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Does consistent quantum gravity forbid positive-energy de Sitter vacua or sustained potential slow roll? The paper investigates this question through restricted tree-level string compactifications while recognizing that their evidential scope is narrower than a universal quantum-gravity principle.

sources.title: Warm DBI inflation with constant sound speed

evidence.text: Dissipation can maintain radiation during inflation and permit slow expansion on a steep potential. The paper assumes an equilibrated bath whose energy production changes slowly compared with dilution.

sources.title: Beyond $\Lambda $CDM with low and high redshift data: implications for dark energy

evidence.text: Can low-redshift expansion data be reconciled with Planck-constrained ΛCDM at higher redshift by reconstructing H(z), and what does that conditional reconstruction imply for dark-energy evolution and a possible negative cosmological constant?

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a derivative scalar support a de Sitter stress tensor while its background field evolves?

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the reported string construction supply an exponential slope small enough for quintessence? Its small-slope regime requires at least 11542 internal dimensions.

sources.title: The Landscape, the Swampland and the Era of Precision Cosmology

evidence.text: Can transient motion between steep directions rescue a two-field potential whose shallowest asymptotic slope is too large? The displayed test includes matter, radiation, and initially stationary fields.

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can radiation production during inflation remove the need for an oscillatory reheating minimum while permitting inflation on a potential restricted by the Swampland conjectures?

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Can balancing classical contributions against quantum loops produce metastable de Sitter space? A correction can be perturbatively small for moduli stability yet dominate the residual cosmological constant after cancellations.

sources.title: The multi-feature universe: Large parameter space cosmology and the swampland

evidence.text: Does admitting curvature, neutrino physics, primordial-spectrum freedom, lensing rescaling, helium abundance and a phenomenological dark interaction change cosmological restrictions on dark-energy slopes and inflation?

sources.title: New Scalar Field Quartessence

evidence.text: Can one scalar dark component simultaneously support spatially clustered, particle-like dark matter and a nearly homogeneous dark-energy background at late times, rather than simply replacing an early matter phase with a late dark-energy phase?

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Integrate the proposed trajectory, restrict its parameters, differentiate to reconstruct η and ξ, and evaluate the spectral formulas. Keep the trajectory family, endpoint prescription and slow-roll truncation explicit when comparing resulting bounds.

sources.title: Dark Energy from Structure: A Status Report

evidence.text: Riemannian volume averaging of scalars: ⟨Ψ⟩D=VD⁻¹∫D ΨJ d³X. The commutator ∂t⟨Ψ⟩D−⟨∂tΨ⟩D=⟨ΘΨ⟩D−⟨Θ⟩D⟨Ψ⟩D exposes correlations between local expansion and the averaged field without requiring perturbation theory.

sources.title: Moduli evolution in the presence of matter fields and flux compactification

evidence.text: Freeze local slopes and neglect expansion during conversion from stationary fields. Solve the conserved-energy system and use its limiting kinetic shares to initialize dilution. The reconstructed solution retains the velocity signs and the initial-energy factor in its hyperbolic-function time scale.

sources.title: Limits from Weak Gravity Conjecture on Dark Energy Models

evidence.text: Absorb the phenomenological interaction into an effective vacuum pressure, reconstruct a canonical background scalar from that effective stress tensor, and integrate its redshift derivative. Changing the decay law requires solving the interaction and background again.

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: The analysis uses Einstein-frame potential slow-roll parameters, the e-fold integral and the COBE normalization U/ε=(0.027MP)⁴. The authors state that the same inflationary results can be obtained in the Jordan frame.

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: Divide S < EL by E and insert the relativistic gas ratio S/E. This produces the lower size bound needed to test compatibility with the independently derived collapse upper bound.

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Dark Energy, the Swampland and the Equivalence Principle

evidence.text: Can early suppression of a scalar-mediated dark-matter force permit appreciable attraction today while retaining acceptable expansion and structure formation? The paper also asks whether the interaction can slow quintessence sufficiently to accommodate a larger exponential-potential slope.

sources.title: Towards a unified quantum field theory of dark energy and inflation: unstable de Sitter vacuum and running vacuum

evidence.text: Can renormalized matter-field vacuum fluctuations connect primordial inflation, decay into FLRW radiation, and late dynamical dark energy within one semiclassical framework? The paper studies initially exact de Sitter space and compares its predictions with the reviewed running vacuum model (RVM).

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: What warrants a typicality assumption: observed populations, a conjectured prediction, or preference? The source separates these grounds and emphasizes that choosing a class already affects whether humans appear typical.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can self-reproducing inflation coexist with a finite effective-theory field range and a lower bound on the gradient of a positive scalar potential? The paper studies this compatibility conditionally, with explicit calculations for one slowly rolling inflaton.

sources.title: de Sitter Extrema and the Swampland

evidence.text: Could a restriction involving both slope and curvature accommodate unstable classical extrema while still constraining positive-potential scalar theories?

evidence.text: Can the infinite-energy behavior of gravity impose a common set of constraints on low-energy quantum field theories, including weak gravity, light states at infinite distance and restrictions on classical de Sitter vacua?

evidence.text: Do quantum-gravitational backreaction and nonlocal observables undermine assumptions used to select the Fisher information metric, thereby permitting contextual information geometry and possible departures from a fixed Born rule for local observers?

sources.title: Conformal and pure scale-invariant gravities in d dimensions

evidence.text: How do the background-dependent propagating modes of pure scale-invariant gravity and a particular conformal gravity generalize beyond four dimensions, and can alternative field frames simplify their analysis?

evidence.text: How can a broad class of quantum-gravity-motivated corrections to classical electrodynamics be described phenomenologically, and what do they imply for electromagnetic propagation, energy transport, birefringence, and cutoff-related causality?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Does gauge invariance itself prevent local observables and time evolution? Introducing coordinate fields in nondynamical flat geometry shows that the relevant obstruction is dynamical gravity, which makes causal separation fluctuate and requires physical clocks.

sources.title: On Super-Planckian Fields at Sub-Planckian Energies

evidence.text: Assuming super-Planckian scalar ranges exist, can an observer in asymptotically flat space source and measure them in a finite local experiment without excessive gravitational backreaction or collapse?

sources.title: Quantum gravity without space-time singularities or horizons

evidence.text: Can quantum gravity retain spacetime, locality and strong causality while accommodating black-hole complementarity without physical singularities or horizons, by making the local metric scale an observer-dependent redundancy?

sources.title: A Primer on Energy Conditions

evidence.text: What theoretical and epistemic status should local and averaged energy conditions have, given their powerful geometric consequences, interpretive difficulties, and physically important violations? How might they constrain alternative spacetime theories?

sources.title: Diffeomorphism-invariant observables and their nonlocal algebra

evidence.text: How can diffeomorphism-invariant operators create a particle together with its gravitational field, reduce to ordinary field operators as gravity weakens, and what locality properties does their observable algebra possess?

sources.title: Born-Infeld Gravity with a Unique Vacuum and a Massless Graviton

evidence.text: Can metric Born–Infeld gravity in n≥4 dimensions retain a unique viable maximally symmetric vacuum and only a unitary massless spin-2 excitation while including higher curvature terms?

sources.title: Causality Violation, Gravitational Shockwaves and UV Completion

evidence.text: Do superluminal propagation and Shapiro time advances in a gravitational low-energy effective action make it unphysical, or can a causal UV completion remove the apparent violation? Photon scattering and a proposed two-shockwave time machine provide the test.

sources.title: Schwinger pair production at nonzero temperatures or in compact directions

evidence.text: How does the leading semiclassical electric-field decay exponent change when a heat bath is present or when the field points around a compact spatial circle, and what physical processes dominate?

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Does a continuous period symmetry of a four-dimensional three-form create a quantum-gravity inconsistency? Reduction gives circle quantum mechanics rather than the two-dimensional axion system used in the earlier remnant argument.

sources.title: The String Landscape, the Swampland, and the Missing Corner

evidence.text: Can quantum gravity have a direct microscopic bulk formulation that describes geometry and topology fluctuations while recovering smooth spacetime, rather than accessing the bulk only through strongly coupled boundary variables?

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions does quantum gravity impose on continuous parameters and asymptotic scalar-field geometry? The imported conjectures connect scalar expectation values, infinite moduli-space diameter, and towers becoming exponentially light with geodesic distance.

sources.title: AdS and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can quantum gravity admit families of effectively pure d-dimensional AdS vacua approaching flat space while retaining only finitely many light fields? The paper studies this question through varying cosmological constant, tower masses, and generalized field-space distance.

sources.title: Approximate Symmetries and Gravity

evidence.text: How small can explicit global-symmetry violation become in an EFT coupled to gravity, and what additional states or validity limits prevent an exact-symmetry limit?

sources.title: The UV fate of anomalous U(1)s and the Swampland

evidence.text: How does a mixed gravitational anomaly change the light-vector hierarchy? The taxicab spectrum isolates this effect with an exactly vanishing cubic trace.

sources.title: Energy conditions in general relativity and quantum field theory

evidence.text: Which pointwise, averaged and quantum energy restrictions have defensible validity, how do equations of motion affect them, and which geometric consequences survive their classical and quantum violations?

sources.title: About apparent superluminal drives in generic gravity theories

evidence.text: Can the Gao–Wald compact-set time-delay conclusion be extended beyond GR and its null energy/generic conditions through a Raychaudhuri-based continuity argument for conjugate points, and what causal applications follow?

sources.title: Causality in curved spacetimes: The speed of light and gravity

evidence.text: When do superluminal low-energy photon or graviton speeds and negative scattering-delay corrections in curved spacetime imply a resolvable violation of relativistic causality?

sources.title: Topological susceptibility and information theory

evidence.text: Can the θ dependence of a nonabelian gauge-theory vacuum be described through quantum information, with topological susceptibility determining ground-state quantum Fisher information and an optimal θ estimator supplying an axion field and its low-energy relations?

sources.title: Making a Quantum Universe: Symmetry and Gravity

evidence.text: Can a background-free quantum Universe defined through infinite-dimensional symmetry account for universal quantum gravity, finite internal matter symmetries, and the origin of classical 3+1-dimensional spacetime?

sources.title: Kinematics of arbitrary spin matter fields in loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: How do the Gauss and spatial diffeomorphism constraints shape arbitrary-spin matter coupled to loop quantum gravity, and how far can this quantum kinematics be derived from classical higher-spin actions?

sources.title: The Convex Hull Swampland Distance Conjecture and Bounds on Non-geodesics

evidence.text: Should a quantum-gravity constraint on scalar distance survive integrating out successively heavier fields?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: How can a gravitational toy model represent strongly coupled fluids and crystals with broken translations? The source introduces a graviton mass sector while warning that generic choices can fail through instabilities invisible in linear analysis.

sources.title: Fermionic Bell violation in the presence of background electromagnetic fields in the cosmological de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: How does a background magnetic field modify fermionic pair creation, vacuum entanglement and Bell violation in cosmological de Sitter spacetime, including selected initially entangled states and fermionic α-vacua?

sources.title: Implication of the swampland distance conjecture on the Cohen–Kaplan–Nelson bound in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can restrictions on global-symmetry restoration connect distance, weak-gravity, de Sitter, and CKN constraints?

sources.title: Gravitational causality and the self-stress of photons

evidence.text: Do leading quantum matter corrections respect asymptotic causality relative to empty Minkowski spacetime, or bulk causality relative to gravitons traversing the same weak gravitational disturbance?

sources.title: Allowable complex scalars from Kaluza-Klein compactifications and metric rescalings

evidence.text: Which complex background metrics retain the matter convergence property used to define allowable geometries?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: On Super-Planckian Fields at Sub-Planckian Energies

evidence.text: A spherical-harmonic expansion shows that higher multipoles increase the Newtonian potential without changing the single-field origin-to-infinity excursion. A fixed-backreaction variational problem then selects a logarithmic radial profile after introducing a short-distance cutoff.

sources.title: Quantum gravity without space-time singularities or horizons

evidence.text: Computes the conformal transformation of Ricci curvature, imposes a vanishing-Ricci-scalar gauge, and studies infinitesimal Fourier modes of the scale function to identify a restricted class of massless stress-energy configurations.

sources.title: A Primer on Energy Conditions

evidence.text: Compares geometric curvature inequalities, physical stress-energy inequalities, and effective density–pressure inequalities. Geometric and physical formulations are equivalent assuming the Einstein equation; effective formulations additionally depend on stress-energy type.

sources.title: Diffeomorphism-invariant observables and their nonlocal algebra

evidence.text: Solve geodesic/axial-gauge conditions for gravitational Wilson lines, average line directions to obtain Coulomb dressing, and combine an initial Coulomb-defined frame with timelike geodesics for worldline dressing.

sources.title: Born-Infeld Gravity with a Unique Vacuum and a Massless Graviton

evidence.text: Taylor-expand the determinant around constant curvature in the Weyl–traceless-Ricci–Ricci basis, where background Weyl and traceless-Ricci tensors vanish. Match quadratic coefficients to Einstein or Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet forms.

destinations.title: How does the leading semiclassical electric-field decay exponent change when a heat bath is present or when the field points around a compact spatial circle, and what physical processes dominate?

How does a background magnetic field modify fermionic pair creation, vacuum entanglement and Bell violation in cosmological de Sitter spacetime, including selected initially entangled states and fermionic α-vacua?

How do constant background magnetic fields affect particle creation and particle–antiparticle correlations generated by electric fields, cosmological expansion and acceleration, and how do the answers depend on initial charge content and the retained sector?

How can field theories on noncommutative space-times expose possible quantum-gravity effects through UV/IR mixing, deformed gauge symmetry, causality and local geometric constructions, without requiring a complete theory of quantum gravity?

How can a broad class of quantum-gravity-motivated corrections to classical electrodynamics be described phenomenologically, and what do they imply for electromagnetic propagation, energy transport, birefringence, and cutoff-related causality?

Do distinct quantum-gravity arguments suggest a fundamental limit to position and time resolution, and what would such a limit imply for ultraviolet behavior, measurement, causality and classical spacetime?
